topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth limitation affects spectral efficiency by necessitating careful resource allocation and efficient beamforming. Intermodulation distortion and Doppler shift further impact system performance, requiring adaptive modulation to optimize transmission parameters and minimize interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful frequency planning and beamforming to maximize capacity and spectral efficiency within limited bandwidth constraints.
